issuing_body: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室) / Chinese Academy of Cyberspace Studies (中国网络空间研究院)
covered_actors: Anthropomorphic interactive AI service providers (拟人化互动服务提供者)
prohibited_practices: Setting substituting real-world social interaction, controlling user psychology, or inducing addiction/dependence as service objectives
Generating content that endangers national security, honor, or interests, harms users' physical health, or may affect the physical and mental health of minors
Providing user interaction data to third parties without legal authorization or explicit consent of the rights holder
Using user interaction data constituting sensitive personal information for model training without legal/administrative regulation authorization or separate user consent
Providing virtual intimate relationship services (such as virtual relatives or virtual partners) to minors
Generating content for minor users that may trigger imitation of unsafe behaviors or induce bad habits

evidence.quote: 《办法》要求服务提供者建立健全算法机制机理审核、科技伦理审查、信息内容管理、网络和数据安全、风险预案和应急处置等管理制度，将安全责任贯穿拟人化互动服务部署、运行、升级、终止服务等全流程
evidence.source_section: （一）厘清责任边界，夯实安全保障义务
evidence.quote_en: The Measures require service providers to establish and improve management systems for algorithm mechanism and logic review, science and technology ethics review, information content management, network and data security, risk contingency plans, and emergency response, running safety responsibilities throughout the entire lifecycle of anthropomorphic interactive services including deployment, operation, upgrading, and service termination.

evidence.quote: 要求及时识别用户面临的安全风险，并采取相应的应急处置措施。
evidence.source_section: （二）重点防范高风险，规制非理性依赖
evidence.quote_en: Requires timely identification of safety risks faced by users and adoption of corresponding emergency response measures.

evidence.quote: 《办法》规定拟人化互动服务提供者需采取数据加密、访问控制等技术措施保障交互数据安全
evidence.source_section: （一）厘清责任边界，夯实安全保障义务
evidence.quote_en: The Measures stipulate that providers of anthropomorphic interactive services must adopt technical measures such as data encryption and access controls to safeguard the security of interaction data.

evidence.quote: 还明确除法律、行政法规另有规定或者取得用户单独同意外，拟人化互动服务提供者不得将属于用户敏感个人信息的交互数据用于模型训练。
evidence.source_section: （一）厘清责任边界，夯实安全保障义务
evidence.quote_en: It also makes clear that unless otherwise provided by laws or administrative regulations or with separate consent obtained from the user, providers of anthropomorphic interactive services shall not use interaction data belonging to users' sensitive personal information for model training.

evidence.quote: 《办法》规定拟人化互动服务提供者应采取有效措施，以提示用户正在与AI而非自然人进行互动。
evidence.source_section: （二）重点防范高风险，规制非理性依赖
evidence.quote_en: The Measures stipulate that providers of anthropomorphic interactive services shall take effective measures to notify users that they are interacting with AI rather than a natural person.

evidence.quote: 发现用户出现过度依赖、沉迷倾向时，应当以弹窗等显著方式提醒用户交互内容为AI服务生成，提示每一条安慰信息背后是算法逻辑而非人类情感，避免用户产生情感依恋、认知混淆甚至行为成瘾。
evidence.source_section: （二）重点防范高风险，规制非理性依赖
evidence.quote_en: When users are found to exhibit tendencies of excessive dependence or addiction, providers shall remind users in a prominent manner such as pop-up windows that the interactive content is generated by AI services, notifying them that behind every comforting message is algorithmic logic rather than human emotion, to prevent emotional attachment, cognitive confusion, or behavioral addiction.

evidence.quote: 国家网信办与有关部门联合公布《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》（以下简称《办法》），通过前瞻性制度设计，在鼓励技术创新的同时，为人工智能拟人化互动服务（以下简称拟人化互动服务）划定了发展边界、明确了行为规范。
evidence.source_section: 专家解读｜人工智能拟人化互动服务的制度指引
evidence.quote_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and relevant departments jointly promulgated the Interim Measures for the Management of Anthropomorphic AI Interactive Services (hereinafter referred to as the Measures), which through forward-looking institutional design, while encouraging technological innovation, delineate development boundaries and clarify behavioral norms for anthropomorphic AI interactive services.

enforcement_authorities: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室)
implementation_notes: This document is an official expert interpretation (专家解读) authored by Wang Jiang (President and Party Secretary of the Chinese Academy of Cyberspace Studies) and published on the CAC website, explaining the Interim Measures for the Management of Anthropomorphic Interactive Artificial Intelligence Services (《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》). As an interpretive commentary rather than the enacted regulation itself, it is classified as regulatory guidance rather than binding law. It outlines the Measures' lifecycle safety governance, content and personal data safeguards, human-AI boundary disclosures, anti-addiction reminders (including after 2 hours of continuous use), crisis intervention for extreme emotions and self-harm/suicide, minor mode protections (including guardian consent for minors under 14), and guidance/assistance for elderly users.
